units.function: Pure tests deriving PAPERCLIP_HOME, per-instance config and shared context paths from data-dir/instance options while preserving explicit environment paths.
units.dependencyDirection: Calls the data-dir environment helper only; no directories, configs or processes are created.
units.keyDataModels: Data root, instance ID, config/context option support and PAPERCLIP_HOME/CONFIG/CONTEXT/INSTANCE_ID variables.
units.lifecycle: Resolves tilde/absolute roots, assigns default instance paths and conditionally applies command-supported defaults.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 4/4. Basic isolation layout is covered; instance/path adversaries, canonicalization, permissions, symlinks, capacity and process collisions are absent, and environment-versus-flag precedence is unclear at this helper boundary.
units.designRationale: Keep multiple local instances under one product home while sharing CLI profile context.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS self-hosted/FDE environments need explicit per-customer and per-profile data lifecycle boundaries without path collision or leakage.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the per-instance layout, but use validated opaque instance IDs, canonical roots, explicit flag precedence, strict modes/ownership and symlink/mount/capacity checks; separate tenant data from operator context and expose lifecycle/backup ownership.
units.responsibilityConflict: Path isolation alone does not authorize which human or Connector may access a customer's data root; filesystem grants must map to data contracts and accountable operators.

units.function: Integration-style test ensuring Doctor repairs JWT and local-encrypted Secret prerequisites, reruns repaired checks and reports no stale failures.
units.dependencyDirection: Runs production Doctor and config store against temporary local resources; it probes filesystem and loopback port but not a live database or external provider.
units.keyDataModels: Structured summary counts, local-trusted deployment, JWT Secret, Secret master-key file, storage/database/log paths, server port and optional runtime checks.
units.lifecycle: Loads config, detects missing prerequisites, repairs them, reruns checks and aggregates pass/warn/fail summary.
units.testAssessment: Sandbox run failed on listen EPERM; escalated rerun passed 1/1 and showed 12 passing checks. Rerun-after-repair is strong, while production/authenticated profiles, external services, partial failure/rollback, stable codes, Secret entropy/permissions/redaction and cleanup are absent.
units.designRationale: Give local operators one self-repairing readiness workflow instead of surfacing stale pre-repair failures.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs deploy-profile-aware diagnostics for identity, database, storage, execution nodes, Connectors, Secrets and data egress before enterprise activation.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the check/repair/rerun state machine and structured summary. Split checks by managed/self-hosted/hybrid profile, keep repairs explicit and transactional, add stable codes/redacted evidence, permissions/entropy/rotation, real service probes and no-change/dry-run output.
units.responsibilityConflict: --yes repair mutates signing and Secret infrastructure without identified accountable approval or exact change evidence; enterprise remediation must bind operator identity, scope and result.
evidence: 2026-08-18 sandbox Vitest: failed on listen EPERM warning
